questions.prompt: What are the three core parts of a Pinia store?

options.text: template, script, style
state, getters, actions
props, emits, slots
data, methods, watchers

questions.explanation: A Pinia store has state (reactive data), getters (cached derived values), and actions (methods that change state, possibly async).

questions.prompt: Why use storeToRefs when destructuring a store?

options.text: To make the store read-only
Destructuring state/getters directly loses reactivity; storeToRefs returns them as reactive refs
To rename the store
It's required to call actions

questions.explanation: Like destructuring a reactive object, pulling state/getters off a store copies values and breaks reactivity. storeToRefs preserves it; actions can be destructured directly.

questions.prompt: What is Pinia's relationship to Vuex?

options.text: Pinia is a plugin for Vuex
Pinia is the officially recommended successor to Vuex, which is now in maintenance mode
They are unrelated
Vuex replaced Pinia

questions.explanation: Pinia is the official, recommended state library for Vue and the successor to Vuex, which is in maintenance.

questions.prompt: You define a Pinia store with the function define______('id', ...). (complete the word)
questions.explanation: defineStore(id, setupOrOptions) creates a store; you then use it via the returned useXStore() function.

questions.prompt: Which state is the best fit for a Pinia store rather than a local ref?

options.text: A counter used by one component only
The logged-in user, needed by many unrelated components across the app
A temporary value inside a single function
A CSS class name

questions.explanation: Pinia shines for genuinely app-wide shared state (user, cart, theme). Component-only data belongs in a local ref.

questions.prompt: Which statements about Pinia are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: Actions can be async (e.g. fetch data then set state)
Getters are cached, like computed properties
You must register Pinia with app.use(createPinia())
A store can only be used in one component

questions.explanation: Actions may be async, getters are cached like computed, and Pinia must be installed with app.use. A store is shared and can be used anywhere.
